definitions.explanation: The act of negating or denying something. In grammar, refers to negative forms of words.
The act of cancelling out or nullifying an effect, action, or statement.

examples.japanese: {打|う}ち{消|け}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
「⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{助動詞|じょどうし}→助動詞：12373_jodoushi⟧だ。
examples.english: 'Nai' is the Japanese negative auxiliary verb.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「ず」⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{助動詞|じょどうし}→助動詞：12373_jodoushi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{使|つか}われた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: In classical grammar, 'zu' was used as the negative auxiliary verb.
I was busy trying to deny the rumors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疑惑|ぎわく}→疑惑：13602_giwaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧だった。
examples.english: He was desperate to deny the suspicions.

examples.japanese: ⟦プラス→プラス：00346_purasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{同時|どうじ}→同時：01592_douji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: Positive effects and cancelling effects occurred simultaneously.

notes:
Derived from the verb ⟦{打|う}ち{消|け}す→打ち消す：06792_uchikesu⟧ (to negate, to deny). Very commonly encountered in Japanese grammar studies, where {打|う}ち{消|け}し refers to negative forms and constructions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {打|う}ち{消|け}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{助動詞|じょどうし}→助動詞：12373_jodoushi⟧: negative auxiliary verb
- {打|う}ち{消|け}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: negative expression
- ⟦{噂|うわさ}→噂：01871_uwasa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{消|け}し: denial of rumors

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{打|う}ち{消|け}す→打ち消す：06792_uchikesu⟧: to negate, deny (verb form)
- ⟦{否定|ひてい}→否定：03707_hitei⟧: negation, denial (more formal/general)
- {取|と}り{消|け}し: cancellation, retraction (of orders, statements)
